title: Tech Note: Basic Principles of Menu Bar Design in 4D

historical_commentary.text: 4D's native menu bar commands and design principles from this era remain part of current 4D, so this note's core guidance on building a low-maintenance menu system remains broadly relevant, even as many modern applications increasingly rely on web-based navigation UI in addition to or instead of native menu bars.
related_updates: 4D's native menu bar commands remain part of the current product, though many modern 4D applications supplement or replace native menus with web-based navigation UI
